A1.justification: Both PDFs describe PLANA3R and contain readable corresponding text, equations, Tables 1–7, Figures 1–12, and Appendix A.1–A.6. The complete material supports a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction, depth, pose-estimation and segmentation experiments, together with threshold and training-data ablations in the main text and appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including PLANA3R benchmark scores, qualitative reconstructions and appendix ablations.

M1.justification: The transformer architecture, hierarchical primitive prediction and selection, patch/rendering/pose losses, plane merging and pairwise multiview inference remain unchanged in Section 3 and the appendix.

E1.justification: The four training datasets and five evaluation datasets remain represented, with the same tasks and overlap scenarios. NYUv2-Plane is relabeled NYUv2, but Section 4.3.2 retains the same 654-frame split sources and monocular depth task; different data coverage is not established.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding tables and qualitative comparisons. MASt3R remains the depth comparator whose scores are revised; the two newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Reported splits, sample counts, metrics, training budgets and inference procedures remain unchanged, including the 654-frame depth evaluation and 50 eight-view samples. The NYUv2 naming revision does not specify changed preprocessing, depth targets or testing procedures.

E4.justification: The primitive-threshold ablation in Table 5, non-overlapping training-pair ablation and overlap analysis in Table 6/Figure 11, and qualitative case studies are retained without substantive revision.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-seed counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. The existing point estimates and aggregate mean/median error reporting remain unchanged in practice.

E6.justification: Table 2 revises five MASt3R entries: Rel 0.160 to 0.152, log10 0.065 to 0.058, δ1 80.6 to 83.0, δ2 94.7 to 95.6, and δ3 98.5 to 98.7. MASt3R consequently ranks ahead of PLANA3R's unchanged 0.059 on log10. Its RMSE, all PLANA3R scores and the other reported results remain unchanged. The revisions are not explained.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations (1)–(5) are unchanged. Removing the trailing comma from the set listed below Equation (4) is a typesetting correction, not revised mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about pose-free metric reconstruction, learning without plane annotations, compact planar representations and zero-shot indoor generalization.

C2.justification: Interpretations of primitive compactness, non-overlapping training pairs and patch-loss convergence are retained. The pairwise multiview restriction and limitations concerning reliable out-of-domain plane annotations remain unchanged. No new interpretation accompanies the revised MASt3R scores.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix A retain the initialization, optimizer, schedule, hardware, augmentation, loss weights, merging thresholds and runtime information. The project-page access information is also unchanged.

R1.justification: The introduction adds citations to Towards in-the-wild 3D plane reconstruction from a single image and MonoPlane, listed as references 18 and 42 in v2. This modestly expands prior-work coverage without revising the positioning argument. Publication updates for existing references do not introduce additional works.

P1.justification: There are limited wording, punctuation and spelling corrections, slight paragraph consolidation, and replacement of NYUv2-Plane terminology with NYUv2. The section order and overall narrative structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Table 2's caption, Table 5's dataset header and Figure 4's caption receive small edits, with minor layout reflow. All figures and tables are retained. Table 2 preserves the old log10 boldface after changing MASt3R's value, leaving PLANA3R incorrectly highlighted as best.

improvement.justification: The added references and copy edits provide modest benefits, but Table 2 introduces an internal reporting inconsistency: MASt3R's revised log10 error is 0.058 versus PLANA3R's 0.059, yet PLANA3R remains bolded under a caption identifying best results. This slightly weakens comparative reporting and outweighs the limited editorial gains. The method and supporting evidence, including the appendices, otherwise remain stable.
